body.name: Calendar-varying finite-memory RIPW class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M(T,p,\mathcal S,\epsilon)=\{(P,\Pi,\mu,m,\tau):\Pi_s\ge\epsilon,\ \pi_s(X)\ge c_{\pi},\ Y_t=Y_t(W),\ \mathbb E_P[Y_t(s)\mid W=s,X]=\mu_t(s,X),\ \mu_t(s,X)=m_t(X)+\sum_{\ell=0}^{p}\tau_{t,\ell}(X)(D_s)_{t,\ell},\ G(\Pi)\succ0\ \text{for all }s\in\mathcal S,\ t\in\{1,\ldots,T\}\}\).
